{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation updates (release notes and files.md) merely document the new index and RPC.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Follow-on documentation edits do not make a functional PR a member of the docs category."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds txoscriptindex under src/index/, implements OrderedVarInt, and modifies txospenderindex.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds a long-requested index type with clear external consumers to replace third-party indexers. Script and address indexing has been requested since 2013 across five PRs, and the design achieves a compact 54 GB footprint on mainnet."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds the getscripthistory RPC method in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp and refactors common raw transaction JSON helpers.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Introduces a new RPC resolving a long-standing application gap that forced downstream services to run separate indexers. Electrum servers, external wallets, and explorers gain the ability to query script history and spenders across block windows."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/test_runner.py only to register the new functional test script.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The functional and unit tests are specific to the new index and RPC rather than modifications to shared test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/init.cpp and index serialization helpers serve the index feature rather than general node utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Index startup wiring and index-specific OrderedVarInt formatting are confined to the index subsystem."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 3,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
